implemented_requirements.requirement: Player ship that can move horizontally at the bottom of the screen
implemented_requirements.evidence: ship.py defines a Ship class with horizontal movement, margin constraints and drawing at the bottom of the screen.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can fire shots with a cooldown and limited number of on‑screen bullets
implemented_requirements.evidence: Ship.try_fire creates a Bullet (from bullet.py) respecting SHIP_FIRE_COOLDOWN and MAX_PLAYER_BULLETS.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Multiple rows of aliens that march, descend and animate
implemented_requirements.evidence: alien_fleet.py creates a grid based on Settings.ALIEN_ROWS and ALIEN_COLS, updates position, changes speed, animates frames and descends.
AlienFleet._alien_fire creates Bullet instances with downward direction.
Ship.lives initialized from Settings.SHIP_START_LIVES and decremented in Ship.hit.
Scoreboard class draws score, high score and wave number; Game stores a score attribute.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when aliens reach the bottom or all are destroyed
implemented_requirements.evidence: No code in the provided files checks for game‑over or victory conditions; Game class lacks the required logic.
Wave handling variables exist (Game.wave, Settings.MAX_WAVES) but no implementation of wave transition or bonus awarding is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Collision detection between bullets and ships/aliens
implemented_requirements.evidence: No collision‑checking code is visible in the supplied files.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Complete main loop that updates and draws all entities
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._loop calls _update and _draw, but those methods are not defined in the excerpt.

critical_issues: Game class is incomplete – _update, _draw, collision handling, state transitions, and game‑over logic are missing.
ship.py uses Bullet without importing it, causing a NameError at runtime.
Two different Settings modules exist (one in main.py, one in settings.py) with incompatible types (hex strings vs. RGB tuples), leading to colour handling errors.
Missing import of tkinter's main loop start (Game.run is defined but never invoked in any script).
No handling of score increment when aliens are destroyed.
judge.summary: While the core entity classes (Ship, Alien, AlienFleet, Bullet, Explosion, Scoreboard) are present and implement many of the requested features, the central Game class lacks the essential update, draw, collision detection, and state‑machine logic required for a functional Space Invaders game. Additional critical bugs (missing imports, duplicate Settings definitions) further reduce the likelihood that the code can be executed as‑is. Consequently the submission does not meet the benchmark requirements.
